title: Fill in the Blank (1 point per blank, 10 total)
instructions: Type the correct answer in each blank. Do NOT use periods to end your answers.

questions.prompt: The component often called the "brain" of the computer, which carries out the program's instructions, is the ___.
The physical parts of a computer that you can actually touch are called ___.
An error that breaks the language's grammar rules and stops the code from compiling is a ___ error.
In Unity, the window where you read the messages printed by Debug.Log is the ___.
A variable declared inside a method is a ___ variable.
A ___ is a named container that stores a single value your program can use and change later.
Writing out a program's logic as plain-English steps before you actually code it is called ___.
A float literal in C# ends with the letter ___ (for example, 4.99 followed by that letter).
A program a user runs to do a specific task, like a game or a web browser, is an example of ___ software.
In a for loop, the counter variable (commonly named i) that tracks the current repetition is called the ___.
